text: Figure 11.26: Scenario: Recover from Critical Supervision Failure in State Management The figure 11.26 shows a scenario for Report Supervision Failure that han- dles recovery from a critical supervision failure in State Management . Such failures are considered as critical failures because State Management is required to recover from supervision failures. Thus, a supervision failure in State Management results in Platform Health Management calling the method FireWatchdogReaction () to perform a restart of the Machine.
